query: SELECT "group".id AS group_id, "group".name AS group_name, character.id AS character_id, character.name AS name, character_group.description AS position              FROM "group"              JOIN character_group ON character_group.group_id = "group".id              JOIN character ON character.id = character_group.character_id              WHERE "group".world_id = ? AND "group".location_id = ? AND "group".id != ?                AND "group".retired_at IS NULL              ORDER BY "group".id, character.id
